idea-plugin.name: Latency Budget Analyzer
idea-plugin.description:
AI-Powered Latency Budget Analyzer

Analyzes your Java/Spring Boot methods for latency hotspots — detecting HTTP calls, database queries, Kafka publishes, Redis operations, and blocking patterns. Provides estimated latency budgets (min/max/p99) per call type and uses AI to suggest concrete optimizations like async conversions, caching strategies, and parallel execution.

Features:

  • PSI-based static analysis of call chains in Java/Kotlin methods
  • Per-operation latency estimates (HTTP, DB, Kafka, Redis, Thread.sleep)
  • Hotspot detection (calls consuming >20% of total p99 budget)
  • Blocking call detection (synchronous operations that should be async)
  • AI-powered optimization suggestions via Claude API
  • Interactive results panel with sortable call chain table

Usage:

Right-click inside any Java/Kotlin method → Analyze Latency Budget
